title: Law of Large Numbers for a random walk on dynamic environments with drift
summary: We study a random walk driven by a particle system from a generic class, and establish a law of large numbers for the walk for almost all densities of the environment. To do so, we exploit the finite-ranged approximations of the environment from arXiv:2409.02096 in a new way, whereby the monotonicity (in the density) of the walker's displacement is leveraged to show the existence of an actual speed.
